meta.title: Punkto — free online scoreboard & leaderboard for classrooms and quiz nights
meta.description: Free scoreboard and leaderboard app for teachers and pub quizzes. Show scores big on a TV or projector, track rounds, crown the winners. No sign-up, works offline, your data stays in your browser.

home.h1: Free scoreboard for classrooms and quiz nights
home.tagline: Keep score on your laptop or phone and show it big on a TV or projector. Leaderboards, rounds, two-team scoreboards and a winner podium — no sign-up needed.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Punkto has no accounts and no database. Everything you create — boards, names, scores, photos and logos — is stored only in your browser's local storage on this device. We never receive it.
privacy.p2: Photos and logos are resized and compressed inside your browser before they are saved. Deleting a board, or using “Delete all data” in the settings, removes it from this device for good.
privacy.p3: Share links contain the board data after the # sign of the address. Browsers never send that part to any server, so the data only travels to the people you give the link to. Photos are not included in links.
privacy.p4: The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub may log technical data such as your IP address when the page loads. Punkto itself uses no analytics and no tracking cookies.
privacy.p5: In the free version, ads are provided by Google AdSense. Google may use cookies to show and measure ads; where the law requires it, you are asked for consent first. Ads can be hidden for the session, and Premium removes all ad code.
privacy.p6: When you activate Premium, your license key is sent to our payment provider Lemon Squeezy to check that it is valid. Payments are handled entirely by Lemon Squeezy — we never see your card or payment details.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.a1: Yes. Every feature is free. Small ads keep the project running — you can hide them for the session for free, or remove them forever with a one-time purchase.
faq.a2: Only in your browser on this device. There are no accounts and no server that receives your boards, names or photos. Use “Copy backup link” or “Export file” to move a board to another device.
faq.q3: How do I show the scores on a TV or projector?
faq.a3: Open your board and click “Display”. A second window opens — move it to the TV or projector and press F for fullscreen. It updates instantly while you change scores.
faq.a4: Yes. After your first visit Punkto works without internet. You can also install it as an app from your browser's menu.
faq.q5: Is it a good fit for schools and the GDPR?
faq.a5: Punkto is built for privacy: no sign-up, and no personal data is stored on any server, so pupils' names and photos stay on the teacher's device. With Premium, no third-party ad code is loaded at all. Please still follow your school's own rules.
